C0559.title: Courier Rejects Main Product but Keeps Free Gifts, Profiting 380,000 Yuan and Receiving Prison Sentence
C0559.summary: A courier exploited his position by ordering electronics online, then rejecting the main items while secretly keeping over 800 bundled free gifts. The cost value of these gifts exceeded 380,000 yuan. By using a 'return the main item, keep the gift' scheme to unlawfully retain the gifts, he was ultimately convicted of fraud and sentenced to two years and ten months in prison.

references.title: Refused Delivery but Embezzled Over 800 Free Gifts: Beijing Courier Sentenced
